guides.title: 光學散射量測：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.concept: 先用「週期標靶：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：散射反演需要明確幾何參數化。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Periodic targets: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Scatter inversion needs explicit geometry parameterization. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜週期標靶：建立模型：散射反演需要明確幾何參數化；節距可固定但須有獨立依據。
觀察站 2｜靈敏度矩陣：建立模型：類似靈敏度向量造成參數難分辨；小奇異值提示弱可識別方向。
觀察站 3｜製程回授：故障判讀與驗證：控制器不應追逐不可識別參數；回授延遲會改變控制穩定性。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Periodic targets: construct and analyze: Scatter inversion needs explicit geometry parameterization; Fixing pitch needs independent evidence.
Observation station 2 | Sensitivity matrix: construct and analyze: Similar sensitivity vectors make parameters hard to separate; Small singular values indicate weak identifiability.
Observation station 3 | Process feedback: diagnose and verify: Controllers should not chase unidentifiable parameters; Feedback latency affects control stability.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「靈敏度矩陣：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「製程回授：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Sensitivity matrix: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Process feedback: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「不定義形狀便宣稱光譜能直接讀出線寬」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「對任何參數都保留任意多小數」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Reading CD directly from spectra without geometry assumptions", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Reporting arbitrary precision for every parameter", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

courses.overview: 從「光學散射量測」延伸比較晶圓臨界尺寸電子顯微量測、晶圓薄膜橢圓偏光量測：先區分量測量與失效機制，再判斷哪些原理可轉用、哪些條件必須重新驗證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Optical scatterometry by comparing Wafer critical-dimension electron microscopy and Wafer thin-film ellipsometry: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: CD-SEM 與散射量測可交叉檢查線寬及輪廓，但比較前須對齊量測定義與空間平均。
related.transferEn: CD-SEM and scatterometry can cross-check linewidth and profile after aligning measurand definitions and spatial averaging.
related.difference: SEM 是局部電子影像的邊緣抽取；散射量測是週期結構光譜反演。二者數值不同不必然代表其中一方錯誤。
related.differenceEn: SEM extracts edges from local electron images; scatterometry inverts spectra from periodic structures. Different values do not automatically invalidate either method.
practice: 指定頂部 CD、底部 CD 與平均 CD 的定義。
比較 SEM 視野與光學光斑的取樣範圍。
將充電偏差與反問題參數相關分開報告。
practiceEn: Define top, bottom and averaged CD.
Compare SEM fields of view with optical sampling spots.
Report charging bias separately from inverse-parameter correlation.
related.title: 晶圓臨界尺寸電子顯微量測

related.why: CD-SEM 與散射量測可交叉檢查線寬及輪廓，但比較前須對齊量測定義與空間平均。
related.whyEn: CD-SEM and scatterometry can cross-check linewidth and profile after aligning measurand definitions and spatial averaging.

related.transfer: 兩者都把光學訊號配合物理模型反推出結構，必須處理 n、k、幾何耦合及不唯一性。
related.transferEn: Both infer structures from optical signals and physical models, requiring treatment of n/k, geometry coupling and nonuniqueness.
related.difference: 散射量測常針對週期圖形；薄膜橢偏常用層狀堆疊。不能把平面膜厚模型直接套用有側壁的光柵。
related.differenceEn: Scatterometry commonly targets periodic features; film ellipsometry commonly uses layered stacks. A planar-film model cannot simply replace a grating model.
practice: 畫層狀膜與光柵的不同模型邊界。
改變一個 n 或幾何參數並比較敏感度。
以第二角度或獨立量測檢查退化解。
practiceEn: Draw different model boundaries for films and gratings.
Perturb one optical or geometric parameter and compare sensitivity.
Use another angle or independent metrology to test degenerate solutions.

courses.summary: 本課以「NIST 量測研究參考園區」作為公開研究、量測或產業歷史的代表地點。從週期標靶、偏振和角度到製程回授：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。 技術由多個地區、企業與研究團隊共同發展；地圖不是唯一發明地，也不是未公開生產設施定位。
courses.summaryEn: This course uses NIST metrology-research reference campus as a public research, metrology or industrial-history reference. From Periodic targets and Polarization and angle to Process feedback: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages. Multiple regions and institutions develop these technologies; the map is neither an exclusive invention claim nor undisclosed production coordinates.
